caption: The drawing depicts a single glass object, specifically a candlestick holder, placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick holder is rendered in shades of pale green with subtle blue undertones, giving it a transparent, slightly reflective appearance that mimics real glass. The holder features a circular base that supports a stem composed of several rounded, bead-like segments stacked vertically. Above the stem, the central portion of the holder bulges outward into a round, bulbous shape before narrowing sharply and then widening again at the top to form the cylindrical opening for a candle. The base is wide and flat, while the top section is open and flared. The signature “JANET RIZA” appears in small letters at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Candlestick
